(a)	To the best of our knowledge and according to the information and explanations given to us, no fraud by the Company or on the Company has been noticed or reported during the period covered by our audit.

statutory_dues.text:
(a)	As explained to us, laws of provident fund & E.S.I are not applicable to the company. The company has generally been regular in depositing the other undisputed statutory dues including income tax, goods and services tax, sales tax, service tax, duty of customs, duty of excise, value added tax, cess and other material statutory dues, applicable to it, with the appropriate authorities. 

According to the information and explanation given to us, no undisputed amounts in respect of income tax, goods and services tax, sales tax, service tax, duty of customs, duty of excise, value added tax, cess were in arrears, as at 31st March, 2025 for a period of more than six months from the date they became payable.

(b)	According to the information and explanations given to us, there are no dues of sales tax, income tax, goods and services tax, custom duty, service tax, excise duty and cess which have not been deposited on account of any dispute.
